summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found before proposing anything:** I had a research agent trace the full path (client `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` fetch wrapper → `modules/watchlist` routes → auth middleware → session store → DB) and also boot the actual server and replay signup → create list → add item → logout → re-login → fetch list via curl.  **Result: on current `master`, the bug as described does not reproduce.** - The client never touches localStorage for watchlist data (only theme). - `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on eve
